theater: 不列顛哈德良長城與東南海岸

battle.name: 大陰謀
battle.theater: 不列顛哈德良長城與東南海岸
battle.brief: 公元367年冬，哈德良長城守軍叛變，皮克特人南下；阿塔科提、斯科特與薩克森人由中部西岸與東南岸登陸，羅軍堡壘失守。368年春，狄奧多西率四支部隊自博洛尼亞渡海，經里奇伯勒進軍倫敦平亂。卡面埃及長矛早三千六百年，不在戰場；當年交手的，是薩克森人的長鐵矛與羅軍的標槍、盾、長劍。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場亂局發生在羅馬帝國西部的外圍，交戰方由三類力量組成。最上層是帝國的中央軍政體系：皇帝瓦倫提尼安一世與其弟瓦倫斯自364年起分治東西，西部由瓦倫提尼安坐鎮萊茵河下游，長子格拉提安以共治者身分在軍中；不列顛在編制上屬西部軍區，由不列顛總督（dux Britanniarum）指揮，轄下有第二奧古斯都、第六勝利等帝國軍團，另有禁衛軍、軍區輔兵與專職的海上警務（comes maritime tractus），以及在島上擔任偵察的地方武裝milites areani。第二類是叛軍：不列顛守軍的部分官兵在哈德良長城舉叛，與自卡雷多尼亞南下的皮克特人、來源不明的阿塔科提、來自愛爾蘭（海伯尼亞）的斯科特人、日耳曼的薩克森人聯手，另有法蘭克人同時在北部高盧登陸，以及被流放至不列顛的帕annon人瓦倫提努斯。第三類是同年並行的另一條戰線：367年羅馬本土爆發反對瓦倫提尼安一世的陰謀，首都元老與軍方高層涉案，規模之大，使後世把這段亂局連同帝國本土的危機一併稱為大陰謀。
countriesEn: This disturbance broke out on the outer edge of the western Roman Empire, and the opposing sides fall into three groups. At the top sits the imperial military and administrative system: since 364 the emperor Valentinian I and his brother Valens had ruled east and west separately, the western half being Valentinian's, based on the lower Rhine, with his elder son Gratian holding the rank of co-ruler in the field. Britannia belonged administratively to the western diocese and was commanded by the dux Britanniarum, with imperial legions such as Legio II Augusta and Legio VI Victrix under him, together with the praetorian guard, auxiliary troops of the diocese, a maritime command (comes maritime tractus) and local scouting agents (milites areani) providing intelligence on the island. The second group are the rebels: part of the British garrison mutinied at Hadrian's Wall and acted together with the Picts coming down from Caledonia, the Attacotti whose origin remains uncertain, the Scoti from Ireland (Hibernia) and the Saxons from Germany, while Franks landed in northern Gaul at the same time; a Pannonian named Valentinus, exiled to Britain, also joined the invaders. The third group is the parallel front of the same year: in 367 a conspiracy against Valentinian I broke out in Roman Italy as well, with senators and senior officers of the army involved, and its scale was such that later generations used the name Great Conspiracy for this whole season of disorder.
people: 關鍵人物是皇帝瓦倫提尼安一世。他本年正在萊茵河一線對付阿勒曼尼，無暇親赴不列顛，只能連續派員代行：第一位是禁衛軍長（comes domesticorum）塞維魯斯，旋即被召回；第二位是騎兵總指揮（magister equitum）尤維努斯，他從北方回報羅馬本島的局勢並請求援軍，仍被召回改派萊茵方向；第三位是狄奧多西，於368年春在博洛尼亞（布洛涅）集結援軍渡海平叛，同行者有其子狄奧多西，後來的狄奧多西一世，以及其姪馬格努斯·馬克西穆斯。亂局中記錄在案的名字有兩位羅馬將官：海上警務指揮涅克塔里杜斯陣亡，不列顛總督富洛法烏德斯被圍困或遭俘；投靠入侵者的帕annon人瓦倫提努斯則被狄奧多西擊敗。善後階段，瓦倫提尼安任命杜爾西提烏斯為新任不列顛總督，另以西維利斯任vicarius主持民政重建，並清除與敵人勾結的地方偵察人員。留下記錄的史家阿米亞努斯·馬爾凱利努斯當時人在安提阿，只能憑二手材料記述，故其時間線多有出入。皇帝本人於367年8月4日授予長子格拉提安奧古斯都名號，這位少年共治者於是提前站上政治前台。
peopleEn: The key figure is the emperor Valentinian I. That year he was engaged against the Alamanni on the Rhine and could not go to Britain himself, so he sent delegates in succession: first Severus, the comes domesticorum, who was recalled almost at once; then Jovinus, the magister equitum, who reported the situation in the island and asked for reinforcements, and was also recalled, being redirected to the Rhine; third Theodosius, who in the spring of 368 gathered a relief force at Bononia (Boulogne) and crossed the sea to end the revolt. With him went his son Theodosius, the future Theodosius I, and probably his nephew Magnus Maximus. Two Roman officers are named in the accounts of the disorder: Nectaridus, the comes maritime tractus, was killed, and Fullofaudes, the dux, was either besieged or captured; the Pannonian Valentinus, who had joined the invaders, was defeated by Theodosius. In the aftermath Valentinian appointed Dulcitius as the new dux Britanniarum and made Civilis a vicarius to head the civil administration, while the local scouts who had collaborated with the enemy were removed from their posts. The historian Ammianus Marcellinus, who preserved the account, was at Antioch at the time and worked from second-hand material, so his chronology is inconsistent. On 4 August 367 the emperor gave his elder son Gratian the title of Augustus, which brought the teenage co-ruler forward onto the political stage.
kits: 卡面上的埃及長矛是一件早王朝時期的文物，約公元前3200年，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。它比這場戰爭早三千六百年，367年的不列顛不可能有人持之作戰，只能當作同類兵器的對照物；它所對應的，正是當年真正決定戰局的長柄刺器。羅馬方面，不列顛守軍以鐵制長矛與標槍（hasta）為主，配橢圓大盾（scutum）與單刃長劍（spatha），御前武裝與儀仗沿用長矛，弩砲（ballista）配以步卒與輕裝援軍，標準旗幟（signum）則是部隊的視覺核心。皮克特人、阿塔科提與薩克森人的裝備簡陋，以長鐵矛、小圓盾、短斧與投槍為主，薩克森另用雙刃短劍（sax）。登陸依靠快速划槳的船隻，羅軍失去制海與情報後，只能以漁船與沿海徵用船應付。真正拖垮這支部隊的，其實是裝備以外的東西：欠餉、缺紀律、脫隊兵與逃奴淪為劫掠者，供應線與屯儲一併失效。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is an artefact of the early dynastic period, around 3200 BC: a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to defend walls and later to recover lost ground. It predates this war by three and a half millennia, and nobody in Britain in 367 could have fought with such a weapon, so it can only serve as a comparison piece for the long-hafted thrusting arms that actually decided the fighting. On the Roman side the British garrison fought with iron spears and the hasta, supported by the oval scutum and the single-edged spatha; the imperial guard and the ceremonial processions still bore the long spear, the ballista was worked by infantry and light auxiliaries, and the signum remained the visual core of a unit. The equipment of the Picts, Attacotti and Saxons was plainer, consisting of long iron spears, small round shields, short axes and javelins, with the Saxons adding the double-edged sax. The landings depended on fast oar-driven craft, and once Rome had lost both the sea control and the intelligence, only fishing boats and requisitioned coastal vessels were available for a counter-stroke. What actually ruined this force lay outside the equipment: arrears of pay, poor discipline, deserters and escaped slaves turned into raiding bands, and supply lines and magazines all failing at once.
tactics: 阿米亞努斯記述的戰法，是一場以速度與分散取勝的多路同時進攻。冬季哈德良長城守軍首先叛變，北段關口洞開；阿塔科提、斯科特人與薩克森人分別由中部西岸與東南部海岸登陸，選的正是羅軍防守薄弱的段落；法蘭克人同時在北部高盧上岸。叛軍不尋求會戰，而以小股劫掠隊活動，押走牲畜與軍用物資，再利用羅軍崩潰形成的真空擴張；更關鍵的是地方偵察人員收取賄賂，使登陸行動完全出乎羅軍意料，突發性成為攻勢的主要來源。羅軍應對分三步：第一步是指揮與情報，瓦倫提尼安兩度更換代行者仍無法直達前線；第二步是登陸與收復，368年狄奧多西趁冬季間隙自里奇伯勒登陸，落地先蒐集情報，確認守軍或潰散、或拒戰、或逃散，隨後把主力移往倫敦作基地，並將部隊化為多股，各擊一路，奪回被劫走的物資；其三是整頓，對脫逃兵宣布赦免以迅速回填被放棄的堡壘，撤換通敵的偵察人員，任命新總督與民政官，處置叛變者，年內收復哈德良長城，369年再以小股兵力驅逐殘餘入侵者，並在北方設立瓦倫提亞，最後配合邊境部族加固整條防線。
tacticsEn: The method Ammianus describes is a set of simultaneous attacks won by speed and dispersal. In the winter the garrison of Hadrian's Wall mutinied first and the northern sector was left open; the Attacotti, Scoti and Saxons landed on the mid-western and south-eastern coasts, choosing precisely the stretches where Roman defence was thinnest, while the Franks came ashore in northern Gaul. The rebels did not seek pitched battle: they worked in small raiding bands, driving off livestock and military stores, and expanded into the vacuum created by the collapse of the Roman line. Crucially, the local scouts had taken bribes, so the landings came as a complete surprise to the defenders, and that surprise was the main source of the offensive's strength. The Roman response ran in three steps. First came command and information: Valentinian twice changed his delegate without reaching the front. Second came the landing and the recovery: in 368 Theodosius used a break in the winter weather to land at Richborough, gathered intelligence on the spot and found the Roman troops overwhelmed, refusing to fight or already in flight, then moved his main body to Londinium as a base, split the force into many parts and struck at each band in turn, tearing away the plunder they carried. Third came the reform: an amnesty for deserters to refill the abandoned forts quickly, the scouts who had collaborated removed, a new dux and civil administrator appointed, the mutineers executed, Hadrian's Wall retaken within the year, the remaining invaders driven out in 369 with small forces, Valentia founded in the north, and the whole line reinforced with the help of the frontier tribes.
data: 可核對的數字有限，只能列出有史料根據者。時間線為：367年冬爆發，368年春援軍渡海，同年年底收復哈德良長城，369年清除殘餘入侵者。狄奧多西的援軍由四支部隊組成，即巴達維人（Batavi）、赫魯利人（Heruli）、約維人（Iovii）與勝利者（Victores），隨軍者另有其子與其姪。折損與俘獲方面有兩名羅馬高級軍官記錄在案：海上警務指揮涅克塔里杜斯陣亡，不列顛總督富洛法烏德斯被圍或被俘。背景數字同樣清楚：350至351年馬格嫩提烏斯爭位之亂抽調大批守軍，多數未再返回不列顛，此後數年軍餉、補給與紀律俱見空缺。同期西線壓力見於367年索利西尼烏姆戰役後阿勒曼尼再渡萊茵、洗劫莫根提亞庫姆，以及瓦倫提尼安冬季在萊茵一線集結意大利與伊利里亞兵員的記載；《軍職大全》後來記載四個阿塔科提營在歐洲大陸服役，說明部分被征服者被收編為帝國武力。史料本身也有缺口：阿米亞努斯當時在安提阿而非不列顛，其敘述係轉述而成，時間線互相矛盾；把事件連結到此前數年乾旱的說法並無確證。至於367年5月羅馬本土另一場反對瓦倫提尼安的陰謀，細節只散見於殘存編年史與Olympiodorus的殘篇，涉案人數與規模皆難以核實。
dataEn: Few numbers can be checked, so only those with a source are given. The chronology runs: outbreak in the winter of 367, the relief force crossing the sea in the spring of 368, Hadrian's Wall retaken by the end of that year, and the last invaders cleared out in 369. The relief force under Theodosius consisted of four units, the Batavi, Heruli, Iovii and Victores, together with his son and his nephew. Two senior Roman officers are recorded among the losses and captures: Nectaridus, the comes maritime tractus, was killed, and Fullofaudes, the dux, was besieged or taken prisoner. The background is equally clear: the rising of Magnentius in 350-351 had drawn a large part of the garrison away, and few of them ever returned to Britain, and in the years that followed pay, supply and discipline all fell away. The pressure on the western front in the same year appears in the aftermath of the battle of Solicinium in 367, when the Alamanni crossed the Rhine again and plundered Mogontiacum, and in the record of Valentinian massing Italian and Illyrian troops on the Rhine in the winter. The Notitia Dignitatum later records four units of Attacotti serving on the continent, showing that some of the conquered were enrolled into Roman forces. The sources themselves have gaps: Ammianus was at Antioch rather than in Britain and worked at second hand, and his narrative contains contradictions; the theory that the events were linked to droughts in the preceding years is unsupported by evidence. As for the other conspiracy against Valentinian in Roman Italy in May 367, its details survive only in a remnant chronicle and in the fragments of Olympiodorus, and neither the number of those involved nor its scale can be verified.
cause: 戰事爆發有數層原因疊加。最深一層是兵源：350至351年馬格嫩提烏斯之亂把不列顛的精銳抽往高盧，戰後多數未歸，邊區只剩編制殘缺、裝備雜亂的守備力量。第二層是中央的注意力：帝國自364年起東西分治，瓦倫提尼安把主要精力放在萊茵河對岸的阿勒曼尼與法蘭克身上，同年還要應付索利西尼烏姆與莫根提亞庫姆的戰事，西部邊疆長期得不到增援；軍隊長期欠餉，士氣與紀律一同崩落。第三層是情報與地方關係：帝國在島上倚賴milites areani一類地方武裝擔任偵察，如今這些人被收買，邊防的耳朵先被堵住，堡壘之間的呼應隨之失效。第四層是形勢本身的牽引力：卡雷多尼亞的皮克特、北海的薩克森與法蘭克、愛爾蘭的斯科特人同時得到機會，於是多路登陸不必事前長期籌劃，一個冬天便可完成。須留意的是，同年羅馬本土也發生反對瓦倫提尼安一世與其子格拉提安的陰謀，首都元老與軍方高層涉案，說明這並非單一戰區的偶發事故，而是帝國分裂後體制普遍鬆動的一次顯現。
causeEn: Several causes stacked up behind the outbreak. The deepest was manpower: the rising of Magnentius in 350-351 had pulled the best of the British troops across to Gaul, and most of them never came back, leaving the frontier with a garrison that was short of numbers, confused in its organisation and mixed in its equipment. The second was where the court's attention was pointing: since 364 the empire had been ruled in two halves, and Valentinian had concentrated on the Alamanni and the Franks across the Rhine, while the same year brought the fighting at Solicinium and the plundering of Mogontiacum, so the western frontier went for a long time without reinforcement; the troops were chronically underpaid, and morale and discipline collapsed together. The third was intelligence and local relationships: the empire relied on agents such as the milites areani to scout and inform on the island, and once those men were bought, the ears of the frontier were blocked first, and the call-and-response between forts failed with them. The fourth was the pull of the situation itself: the Picts of Caledonia, the Saxons and Franks of the north sea and the Scoti of Ireland were all offered the same opportunity at once, so that a set of coordinated landings no longer needed long preparation and could be carried out in a single winter. It should be noted that in the same year a conspiracy against Valentinian I and his son Gratian also broke out in Roman Italy, with senators and senior officers involved, which shows that this was not an accident confined to one theatre but a visible symptom of the general loosening of the imperial order after the division of the empire.
impact: 這場戰事留下的不是戰功紀念碑，而是一整套體制調整。軍區層面，地方偵察人員的職務被廢除，情報改由軍方直接掌握；不列顛總督改由杜爾西提烏斯接任，民政另設vicarius由西維利斯主持，兩者分權，避免再出現全軍隨一人叛走的局面；哈德良長城重新設防，並與沃塔迪尼等邊境部族合作，由地方首領帕泰爾努斯一類人物承擔防衛；極北另建瓦倫提亞，以便更有效地管治愛奧納以北的地區。編制層面，四個阿塔科提營後來出現在《軍職大全》的歐洲大陸名單中，可見被征服者被收編為帝國武力是常態。軍人政治層面最為深遠：狄奧多西因平叛之功取代尤維努斯，成為瓦倫提尼安的首要軍事顧問，其子狄奧多西與姪馬格努斯·馬克西穆斯都在這場戰役中嶄露；父子兩代隨後先後登上皇帝之位，馬克西穆斯更於383年一度自立為帝，隨即被狄奧多西一世平定，羅馬西部的皇權交接就此被打亂重排。帝國整體層面，大陰謀顯示西部邊疆已無足夠常備軍力，防守必須依賴臨時徵召與跨海援軍；此後薩克森、法蘭克與北方部族的襲擾在英格蘭沒有停止，羅馬對不列顛的控制逐步轉為名義上的宗主治權。
impactEn: What this war left behind was not a record of victories but a complete reorganisation of the system. At the level of the diocese, the office of the local scouts was abolished and intelligence passed directly to the army; the command of Britain went to Dulcitius, while civil administration was placed in the hands of Civilis as vicarius, dividing authority so that the whole army could not once again follow a single man into rebellion; Hadrian's Wall was fortified afresh and defended with the help of frontier peoples such as the Votadini, with local leaders like Paternus taking part in the defence; and in the far north Valentia was founded so that the region beyond the Ayr could be governed more effectively. At the level of organisation, four units of Attacotti later appear on the continental lists of the Notitia Dignitatum, showing that the enrolment of the conquered into Roman forces was the normal practice. The deepest effect was political within the army: Theodosius, who had ended the revolt, replaced Jovinus as Valentinian's leading military adviser, and both his son Theodosius and his nephew Magnus Maximus came to prominence in this campaign; the father and son were in turn raised to the imperial office, and Maximus in 383 even set himself up as emperor before being put down by Theodosius I, so that the succession in the western empire was disturbed and rearranged. At the level of the empire as a whole, the Great Conspiracy showed that the western frontier no longer had enough standing troops and that defence had to rest on ad hoc levies and reinforcements shipped across the channel; the raids of the Saxons, Franks and northern peoples in England did not stop afterwards, and Roman control of Britain gradually became a nominal suzerainty.
result: 結果分短期與長期兩層。短期方面，到368年年底，哈德良長城收復，叛變的守軍首領被處決，東南與中西部失守的堡壘重新屯防，脫逃兵經赦免後回隊，軍區秩序大體恢復；369年狄奧多西再以小股兵力驅逐殘餘入侵者，其中包括被流放至不列顛的帕annon人瓦倫提努斯，並在北方設立瓦倫提亞，此後數年北境趨於安寧。長期方面，造成戰亂的條件大部分仍在：欠餉、缺員、偵察網瓦解、常備軍不足，因此襲擾在英格蘭沒有中斷，羅軍只能靠跨海派兵與本地徵召勉力維持。與此同時，367年5月爆發於羅馬本土的那場反對瓦倫提尼安一世的陰謀同樣被鎮壓：據殘存編年史與史家殘篇，被推舉的涅波斯在位僅數日即被殺，涉案的東部軍務長馬塞利努斯遭到清算，瓦倫斯於368年入羅馬，在元老院公開處置涉案者。可以確定的是，大陰謀之後羅馬帝國西部仍能作戰，但每一次作戰都更加依賴少數能打的部隊與臨時拼湊的聯軍；四世紀下半葉的不列顛，將長期處在這樣的守勢之中。
resultEn: The outcome has a short term and a long term. In the short term, by the end of 368 Hadrian's Wall had been retaken, the leaders of the mutiny executed, the forts abandoned in the south-east and the mid-west re-garrisoned, deserters returned to the colours after the amnesty and the order of the diocese largely restored; in 369 Theodosius drove out the last of the invaders with small forces, including the Pannonian Valentinus who had been exiled to Britain, and Valentia was founded in the north, after which the northern frontier was quiet for several years. In the long term, most of the conditions that produced the revolt were still in place: arrears of pay, gaps in the ranks, a shattered intelligence network, insufficient regulars. Raiding in England therefore did not stop, and the Roman army could only hold on with troops sent across the sea and with locally raised men. At the same time the conspiracy against Valentinian I that broke out in Roman Italy in May 367 was also suppressed: according to the remnant chronicle and the fragments of the historians, Nepos, who had been acclaimed, lasted only a few days before being killed, the eastern praetorian prefect Marcellinus was called to account, and Valens entered Rome in 368 to deal with the guilty in front of the senate. What can be certain is that after the Great Conspiracy the western Roman Empire could still fight, but every campaign relied more and more on a handful of serviceable units and on coalitions patched together on the spot; and for the rest of the second half of the fourth century Britain would remain largely on the defensive.
